name: hr-id-card-automata
description: Progressive Web App to generate HR ID cards from employee data. Local-first, template-driven, exportable to PDF and DOCX. Features a drag-and-drop template designer with layer-based editing, touch controls, rotation support, undo/redo, gradient/glassmorphism design tools, toast notifications, template library, cookie consent, and SEO optimization.
majorCapabilities: Drag-and-drop visual template designer with text, image, shape, and barcode layers
Canvas-based layer editing with snap-to-grid, icon-based resize/rotate handles (larger for touch), and property inspector
Undo/redo history stack (50 steps) for template editing with keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z)
Gradient backgrounds (linear/radial) for text, shape, and image layers with color pickers
Glassmorphism effects (blur + opacity) for text, shape, and image layers
Border styles (solid/dashed/dotted) with color pickers for text, shape, and image layers
Touch-enabled controls for drag, resize, and rotate via unified pointer events (mouse, touch, pen)
Front/back dual-sided template support with side toggle in designer and preview
Responsive canvas with auto-scaling zoom controls; mobile canvas accessible inline below controls
Mobile-responsive layout: designer canvas appears below TemplateEditor on small screens, side-by-side on wide screens
Template library with save, load, rename, delete, export/import JSON
Toast notification system for manual save, load, import, and export actions (not on auto-save)
Import templates from image files (PNG/JPG) as tracing backgrounds
GDPR-compliant cookie/localStorage consent banner with graceful fallback
Dynamic SEO meta tag injection (Open Graph, Twitter Cards, JSON-LD)
Full backward compatibility with legacy CardConfig template format via migration
Rotation property in layer panel for element positioning
Dark/light theme with local persistence
Dynamic employee data entry fields based on template variables ({{fullName}}, {{department}}, {{role}}, {{idNumber}}, {{issueDate}})
Template text context hints in employee data entry (shows non-variable text from template layers)
Canvas-based export renderer that faithfully reproduces designer template layers (gradients, glassmorphism, borders, rotation) in PDF and DOCX
Back-of-card export: templates with hasBackSide flag render back layers as separate pages in PDF/DOCX
End-to-end template-export pipeline: designer template → canvas renderer → PDF/DOCX image embedding
Default migration uses {{variable}} syntax so exports reflect actual employee data
